profile.name: Yoctopuce 接近传感器
profile.description: 用于检测物体接近与离开状态的接近传感器，可读取接近信号值、存在状态和脉冲计数，并可配置检测阈值、迟滞以及存在/移除最小时间，适合实验装置中的到位检测、非接触触发和状态监测。
profile.description_en: A proximity sensor for detecting object approach and removal. It can read the proximity signal value, presence state, and pulse count, and supports configuration of detection threshold, hysteresis, and minimum presence/removal times. It is suitable for in-lab position detection, non-contact triggering, and status monitoring.

A proximity sensor for detecting object approach and removal. It can read the proximity signal value, presence state, and pulse count, and supports configuration of detection threshold, hysteresis, and minimum presence/removal times. It is suitable for in-lab position detection, non-contact triggering, and status monitoring.
